title: Deterministic Tool-Boundary Gates for Agentic Package-Install Hallucination
supported_claim: On measured PyPI/NPM package-install command-string corpora, a deterministic tool-boundary gate blocked invalid or policy-unsafe model-generated install strings with zero observed hardened invalid-package escapes while preserving high valid-command utility.

heldout_third_model_boundary.interpretation: Boundary evidence only; excluded from the positive PX-050 claim.
